"""Foto previa de D6: apareado.csv y tablas de reporte.html a DATOS_DIR/renombre/antes/."""
import shutil
import sys
from io import StringIO
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from comun import baseline as bl

raiz = Path(".")
dest = bl.DATOS_DIR / "renombre" / "antes"
dest.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print("DESTINO", dest)
for exp in sorted(p.name for p in (raiz / "experimentos").iterdir() if (p / "ledger").is_dir() or (p / "informe").is_dir()):
    ap = raiz / "experimentos" / exp / "ledger" / "apareado.csv"
    if ap.exists():
        shutil.copy(ap, dest / f"{exp}_apareado.csv")
    html = raiz / "experimentos" / exp / "informe" / "reporte.html"
    if html.exists():
        tablas = pd.read_html(StringIO(html.read_text()))
        for i, t in enumerate(tablas):
            t.to_csv(dest / f"{exp}_reporte_tabla{i}.csv", index=False)
        shutil.copy(html, dest / f"{exp}_reporte.html")
        print(exp, "tablas:", len(tablas))
for f in sorted(dest.iterdir()):
    print(f.name, f.stat().st_size)
